title: Wolf HUDs chooser
layout_order: title Wolf HUDs | intro line | Choose tiles... / Done, Show all | scrolling grid of 256 x 108 tiles, three to a row (two or one in a narrow window), in reading order: Game Mode, Car Dashboard, Winter Fun / Flight Deck, Spaceship, Sailing Deck / Captain's Helm, Speedboat, Submarine / Greedy, Roleplay, Tessa's Compass / WolfSpeed, Fishing, Train Cab / Weather Props, Tutorial Videos, Train Builder / Lay Railway Track, WolfTrek (Space); each tile picture left, name, words, state line | status line at the bottom. Opened by the HUDs button (bottom right).

controls.name: huds-button
controls.label: HUDs (labelled, bottom right of the toolbar strip; lit while the window shows)
controls.tip: Wolf HUDs: the game, flight, sailing, driving and winter HUDs - pick one to show or hide it (Wolf Territories)
controls.action: LLFloaterReg::toggleInstance("wolf_huds")
source: tool_tip="Wolf HUDs: the game, flight, sailing, driving and winter HUDs - pick one to show or hide it (Wolf Territories)"

controls.name: menu
controls.label: Wolf World > Vehicles & Travel > Wolf HUDs...
controls.action: Floater.Show wolf_huds

controls.name: intro
controls.label: Press a picture to show or hide that HUD. A green dot and ON mean it is showing. (choosing: Choosing: press a picture to show or hide it in this window...)
controls.action: fitToArea keeps it wrapped
source: Press a picture to show or hide that HUD. A green dot and ON mean it is showing.</text>
"Choosing: press a picture to show or hide it in this window. Hidden ones stay in the Wolf World menu. Press Done when you have finished."

controls.label: Choose tiles... / Done (while choosing)
controls.tip: Pick which tiles show in this window. Hidden ones stay in the Wolf World menu, and their HUDs still work.
controls.action: setChoosing(toggle state): a tile press then hides or shows that tile here (saved at once in WolfHudsHidden), never runs its HUD
source: tool_tip="Pick which tiles show in this window. Hidden ones stay in the Wolf World menu, and their HUDs still work."

controls.label: Show all
controls.tip: Show every tile in this window again
controls.action: showAll(): every tile shown again, saved
source: tool_tip="Show every tile in this window again"
